t: Proposed Inauguration Of The School For Children Of Soviet Citizens In Shanghai

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
S.I, Special Branch Statistics
REPORT
Date August 7, 1933.

Subject (in full) Proposed inauguration of the School for Children of Soviet
Citizens in Shanghai.

Made by D.S. Pavloff    Forwarded by C Gasko

With reference to the attached translation from
the "Lainichi" of August 2, 1939, Mr. V. Rossi of the
Political Section, French Police, was communicated with
and it was learned that no official application for
permission to operate the proposed school, has yet been
received by the French Police.

It was learned by the undersigned that should
the school be inaugurated, Mr. Klimenko, Translator of
the Soviet Consulate, will be the Principal and Mrs. E.
Miroshnikoff, an active member of the Women's section of
the Soviet Citizens' Club, will be the Head Mistress.
Mrs. E. Miroshnikoff's daughter is married to Mr. E.A.
Karukes, Soviet Citizen, co-proprietor of the Fleet's
Book Store, 798 Avenue Joffre.

Should the application be received by the French
Police a further report will be submitted in due course.

A. C. Pavloff
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)

S.I, 特别处统计
报告
日期：1933年8月7日。

主题（全称）：拟在上海创办苏联公民子女学校。

制作人：D.S. Pavloff    转呈人：C Gasko

关于附上的1939年8月2日《每日新闻》（Lainichi）译文，已与法国警察厅政治科的 V. Rossi 先生取得联系，获悉法国警察厅尚未收到关于运营该拟议学校的正式许可申请。

据本报告人了解，若该校成立，苏联领事馆翻译克利缅科（Klimenko）先生将担任校长，苏联公民俱乐部妇女部活跃成员 E. Miroshnikoff 女士将担任女校长。E. Miroshnikoff 女士的女儿嫁给了苏联公民 E.A. Karukes 先生，后者是霞飞路798号“舰队书店”（Fleet's Book Store）的共同所有人。

若法国警察厅收到相关申请，将在适当时候提交进一步报告。

A. C. Pavloff
D. S.

副总监（特别处）

August 2, 1939.

MAINICHI

SOVIET CONSULATE-GENERAL TO ESTABLISH A LABOUR
SCHOOL FOR RUSSIAN CHILDREN

It is reported that Mr. B. M.
Simansky, Russian Consul-General at Shanghai, acting
on instructions from the Soviet Government, will
establish a labour school for the education of the children
of the 2,000 Soviet citizens in Shanghai.
Mr. V. N. Crimenko, Chief of the
Judicial Section of the Soviet Consulate, and Mrs. L. P.
Mironikova(?), Secretary of the Soviet Russian Club have
been appointed to a Preparatory Committee to make arrangement
for the establishment of the school. It will have its
office in the Soviet Russian Club, No. 805 Avenue Foch,
French Concession.
The proposed school will have
accomodation for about 200 children of Soviet citizens
and about 50 of pro-Soviet Russians.
It is interesting to see what
attitude the Settlement authorities will adopt in this
matter.

1939年8月2日。

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

苏联总领事馆将为俄国儿童设立一所劳动学校

据报道，驻上海俄国总领事 B. M. Simansky 先生奉苏联政府指示，将为在上海的2,000名苏联公民的子女教育设立一所劳动学校。
苏联领事馆司法科科长 V. N. Crimenko 先生和苏俄俱乐部秘书 L. P. Mironikova(?) 女士已被任命进入筹备委员会，负责安排建校事宜。校址将设在法租界霞飞路805号苏俄俱乐部内。
拟议中的学校将容纳约200名苏联公民子女和约50名亲苏俄国人子女。
租界当局对此事将采取何种态度，值得关注。

translation

In view of the proposed opening during the next
school term of a Soviet Middle School in Shanghai for
children of Soviet citizens,persons wishing to place
their children in that school are requested to apply
for information before June 4 to V.N.Klimenko and
Mrs E.P. Miroshnikoff at the Soviet Citizens' Club,
805 Avenue Foch, tel. 76735.
